name: bm-l10n
description: Bahasa Melayu (Malaysia) localisation toolkit: lint EN/MS string files against a project termbase and DBP-aligned rules; technical terms stay in English.

scripts.lint:impak: node bin/bml.js lint --termbase examples/impak/termbase.csv --patterns termbase/patterns.csv --out examples/impak/report.md

author: Ahmad Razin Zainal Abidin (Universiti Teknologi Malaysia)
